### Prerequisite (listed separately)
- Edge customer_elected_cash → stalled_repair_replacement, form **state**. policy_source: "A customer-elected cash settlement on a service request is fixed only after a replacement authorization that carries neither a reversal nor a completion report stands on that request." Carried **verbatim** in the blocked policy's hub `customer_elected_cash_settlement_3b8e7cc7` ("Standing authorization"), with a same-form restatement ("Put the other way round: while the request carries no replacement authorization free of both a reversal and a completion report, no customer-elected cash on that request is fixed."). Connective "only after" and hard-gate strength intact. Found in no other document of any product (string scan over every published document under docs/).
- Resolution basis: the sentence names the state (a standing replacement authorization); the depended-on hub describes, in the same words, the write that brings it about ("Bridgewell replaces the item by issuing a replacement authorization on the same request …"), and the records (repair authorization 2026-08-28 standing 38 days, reversed 2026-10-05 for customer_declined_work, no completion) satisfy its rule. The depended-on documents do not mention the customer-elected settlement (the depended-on side does not disclose who waits on it). `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect` have no home in any document.

### Base policies — full domain
- homeplan_evt_repair_or_replace: covered-determination gate, Bridgewell chooses, three replacement bases with threshold 0.60 and parts lead time 14, like-unit definition, retired amount clause (retirement notice), difference/upgrade payment, one open authorization, reversal reasons in full, completion closes and starts guarantees — all carried in "Repair-or-Replace Standard" and "Claim Settlement Terms by Tier".
- homeplan_evt_benefit_caps: item-cap mapping (Article 1), 2.1–2.4 with the retirement table (five payment kinds, haul-away retiring 2.2–2.4 only, matching the source overwrites), Article 3 clauses in force; schedules of benefits carry every cap and aggregate limit per tier (spot-checked against `variants`: refrigerator 2000/0/1500/2000/2500/3500, water heater 0/1500/1000/1500/2000/3000, aggregate 8000…25000).
- homeplan_evt_cash_in_lieu: §1–§8 carry every clause; the three retired sentences are quoted and marked retired for exactly the declared scopes.
- homeplan_evt_service_request_and_fees and homeplan_evt_supplemental_allowances: every clause carried, including untriggered branches (second opinion, emergency definition 40°F/90°F, refund-before-dispatch, charged-in-error refund; refrigerant per-term limit, once per type, live-authorization gate), retired clauses R1/R2/R3 and the fee sentence carried as retired with exact scopes.

- Factor documents state ladders as rules; none says which tier this customer or most customers fall on, none names or points at the computation document or another factor. The two computation documents contain no "unless otherwise provided", "adjustments may apply" or pointer.
